description: Removes a member entirely from a specific Trello organization, including from all its boards and cards; this action is permanent and does not delete the member's Trello account.

idMember.description: The ID of the member to remove from the organization.
idMember.title: Id Member

idOrg.description: The ID or short name (slug) of the organization.
idOrg.title: Id Org

name: remove_member_from_org

RemoveMemberFromOrgResponse.description:
Response schema for DELETE /1/organizations/{id}/members/{idMember}/all endpoint.

Returns an empty response body with HTTP 200 OK status code to indicate successful removal
of the member from the organization and all associated boards. This follows the standard
Trello API pattern for DELETE operations where an empty response with 200 status confirms
successful deletion.
RemoveMemberFromOrgResponse.title: RemoveMemberFromOrgResponse
